people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jehoiada
people.line: High priest who overthrew Athaliah and crowned Joash

translations.web: Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds the spears, and bucklers, and shields, that had been king David’s, which were in God’s house.
translations.bsb: Then Jehoiada the priest gave to the commanders of hundreds the spears and the large and small shields of King David that were in the house of God.
translations.kjv: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears, and bucklers, and shields, that had been king David's, which were in the house of God.
translations.asv: And Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds the spears, and bucklers, and shields, that had been king David's, which were in the house of God.
